# Authentic8 careers

We build groundbreaking products that transform web security. Our employees make it possible.

[Open Positions](https://authentic8.com/careers/#open-positions)

## Creating a culture of achievement and innovation

##### We believe in what we do. We don’t just make products — we solve real-world problems. We’re always on the lookout for people who share our values.

Looking for a place where you’re valued for your contributions? Where you can keep growing and work with amazing people? You’ve found it! At Authentic8, we strive to keep our people engaged, interested in their work, and excited about the future.

## What you’ll find working at Authentic8

![Integrity and ownership — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Authentic8-integrity-ownership-icon.png)

### Integrity & Ownership

We apply our best efforts and are responsible for our actions, our reputation, and our business.

![Mission-focused — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Authentic8-mission-focused-icon.png)

### Mission-Focused

We clearly define and communicate our goals and do not stray in the pursuit of our objective.

![Respect — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Authentic8-respect-icon.png)

### Respect

We value and respect the ideas and experience our diverse backgrounds bring us.

![Collaborative environment — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Authentic8-collaborative-environment-icon.png)

### Collaborative Environment

We recognize the best work is the product of teams. We must each be reliable and expect to rely on others.

![Transparency — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Authentic8-transparency-icon.png)

### Transparency

By operating with common information and understanding, we ensure that we are aligned.

![Innovative solutions — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Authentic8-innovatice-solutions-icon.png)

### Innovative Solutions

We seek innovative solutions as a means to solve difficult problems with zeal, efficiency, and quality.

## What our employees have to say

I am beyond grateful to be at an organization like this. Not every day do you get to say you work for a company that assists in tracking down “the bad guys.”

I enjoy working with Authentic8 because of our mission and the impact we have across the world!

One of the things I most cherish about working here is how valued and heard our employees are. It’s not just about having a seat at the table; it’s about knowing that our voices matter.

## Perks of working at Authentic8

![Work-life balance — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Authentic8-balance-icon.png)

### Balance

Flexible work practices, paid time off, and holidays.

![Competitive compensation — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Authentic8-Competitive-compensation-icon_.png)

### Competitive compensation

Salary and bonuses, 401K and equity.

![Mind-body wellness — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Authentic8-mind-body-wellness-icon.png)

### Mind and body wellness

Comprehensive healthcare coverage.

![Team culture — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Authentic8-team-fun-icon.png)

### Team fun

Casual and creative work atmosphere that also celebrates group outings and activities.

![Charity and giving — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Authentic8-charity-giving-icon.png)

### Charity and giving

Support for employee volunteering initiatives and annual charitable giving.

![Mentorship and growth — Authentic8 core value icon](https://authentic8prd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Authentic8-mentorship-growth-icon.png)

### Mentorship and growth

Small group project assignments in a continuous learning environment.

## See our open positions

Don’t see a position you are looking for? Email us your resume at [hr@authentic8.com](mailto:hr@authentic8.com), and let us know what you can bring to Authentic8. Please note, we do not accept resumes from outside recruiters.

## Any questions?

Contact an Authentic8 expert today — we'd be happy to chat!

[Contact Us](https://authentic8.com/contact-us/)
